_comment: Current probes (Strategy keeps this up to date). name -> level (relative to driver_personal/chicago), optional build (exe folder, default build-dev). python driver_personal/probes.py sync publishes each as a self-contained copy in <Desktop>/Driver Probe Tests/NAME (OneDrive -> laptop). NOTE: 'env' only feeds the PACKAGE BUILD (converter/build_package switches); runtime/plugin switches (e.g. CHI_C88_*) are NOT passed to the running game, so a runtime variant needs its own build/default.

d2 cities 3.what: Probe 'd2 cities 3' (= d2 cities 2 + your review fixes) (3-disc). NEW: every Driver 2 city has its own day/night sky (no more Havana sky everywhere); no sound when a Driver 2 map starts loading; Las Vegas/Havana/Rio nights look like Driver 2 (lit casino neon and signs, Havana lamp heads lit, Vegas pole traffic lights glow); Mods > Quality of Life > 'Rewind' is its own setting; the 'Chicago' section is now 'Full Pro experience' with a required-for-custom-maps warning. From d2 cities 2: Las Vegas + Rio, dark night roads, Havana chase music, Driver 2 car sounds, pause-menu map in Driver 2 cities. Known: police sirens still Driver 1's; Vegas lake walled; Rio misses 2 special cars; D2 night shading of buildings/cars and lamp streaks not yet (C132); traffic still drives Driver 1's grid (C129, Q72); Chicago night unchanged (Q73); Chicago/Havana start in the secret car (Q69).
